# Solana Icons

> Open-source icon library for the Solana ecosystem.

- Site: https://icons.sol.new
- npm: `npm i solana-icons`
- License: MIT
- Icons: 370+ SVG/PNG (wallets, platforms, brand, infrastructure)
- GitHub: https://github.com/metasal1/solana-icons

## Use

- Browse and download SVG/PNG on the website
- Install package for React/app usage
- Request icons via GitHub issues

## Key URLs

- https://icons.sol.new/
- https://icons.sol.new/llms-full.txt
- https://icons.sol.new/sitemap.xml
- https://icons.sol.new/images/opengraph.png
